Cutaway: left side panel, front cover plates and the front of the roof removed. Heights from the nutclip hole numbers in ND Book 2 chapter 16; outer size from the ND-5700/5800/5900 product sheet.
Drawn schematic, not to exact scale. Sources: Book 2 ch. 16 and 17 (ND-B2C16.pdf, ND-B2C17.pdf); ND-05.020 Hardware Description; ND-SID001 sales document.
Colour: taupe brown, from a photograph of an ND-5800 at Telemuseet and ND-SID001's "brown/beige cabinet". Samson CPU edge drawn from photographs of assembly 320003.
